messages:
Nina (Partnerships): Quick heads-up: EdgeBridge wants to embed a LangChain-ready adapter + orchestration hooks so their market customers can route tasks to EdgeBridge HW. They're asking for a marketplace-ready connector and a co-announcement window in late June. Who can take lead on cert checklist + announcement timeline?
Ethan (Product): I can own the marketplace checklist and announcement cadence. Suggest gating on: security scan, sample app, 2 SI partners validated, and billing integration for metered usage. Proposed announce: 2026-06-24 (tentative).
Ravi (Eng-ML): Technical note: LangChain connector needs to support streaming + a model-fallback path to a hosted small model. For orchestration we should expose a run_priority flag and device affinity. Would like to trial with two workloads: chat multi-turn and long-form summarization.
Clara (Eng-Runtime): From runtime side we need an adapter shim for device discovery and an orchestration hook for placement decisions. Estimate M1 (auth + basic API + smoke tests) in 2 sprints; M2 (telemetry + function-calling + autoscale signals) in 2 more. Also need to validate quantized model artifacts on EdgeBridge GPU variants.
Omar (DevEx): DevEx can supply a starter repo (langchain-edgebridge-quickstart) and a Hosted->Dedicated routing sample. Will need partner sandbox creds and sample prompts. I can prep a README and a workspace tutorial.
Samir (Sales): We'll coordinate customer POC outreach. Suggest we secure 2 anchor customers for launch (one SI-led, one direct). Sales can provide potential POC names. Also confirm ISV marketplace revenue share terms with finance.
EdgeBridge (Partner): We'll provide sandbox endpoints, test device images, and a firmware compatibility matrix by EOD Friday. Also our marketing folks want a 2-week embargo before any public announcement.
MarketplaceBot: Marketplace listing requirements: security_scan:true, sample_app:true, billing_schema: metered_per_token, terms_signed:false, images_needed:true
Nina (Partnerships): Good. Ethan, please add the marketplace gating matrix into the spec doc. Clara/Ravi, can you add a minimal compatibility matrix for the different EdgeBridge SKUs?
Ethan (Product): Will do. I'll create the spec doc and checklist: https://redwood.internal/partnerships/edgebridge-marketplace-spec.md
Clara (Eng-Runtime): We'll include expected latencies and recommended batching defaults. Quick suggestion for golden defaults to include in the sample app:
```
batch_size: 6
max_tokens_per_request: 1024
prefetch_kv: true
fallback_model: "hosted-small-v1"
```
Also we'll surface an "edge_telemetry" blob with CPU/GPU temperature and power usage metrics.
Ravi (Eng-ML): Note for LangChain SDK: include an Orchestrator.run_job API that accepts device_affinity and function hooks for device_status/start_job. Add a short example to DevEx sample.
Omar (DevEx): Copy that. I'll scaffold the example with LangChain's Agent + Orchestrator shim. ETA for sample app: 5 working days once partner creds available.
LegalBot: Please route the NDA addendum & marketplace terms to Legal. Export controls flagged: yes (EdgeBridge hardware), expect review 3 business days.
Samir (Sales): For SI integration, we need a mapping of supported SIs and a co-sell contact list. Partner also requested a joint webinar — tentatively 2026-07-15.
EdgeBridge (Partner): Webinar date 2026-07-15 works; we'll coordinate assets. Sandbox creds will be shared via SFTP link tomorrow morning.
Nina (Partnerships): Action items recap: Ethan = spec + checklist; Clara/Ravi = runtime + compat matrix; Omar = quickstart + sample app; LegalBot = contracts/controls; Samir = POC list + webinar planning; EdgeBridge = sandbox creds + firmware matrix. I'll book a 45-min integration kickoff Thu 11am PT. React with :white_check_mark: if you can make it.
Clara (Eng-Runtime): :white_check_mark:
Ravi (Eng-ML): :white_check_mark:
Omar (DevEx): :white_check_mark:
Ethan (Product): :white_check_mark:
Samir (Sales): :white_check_mark:
EdgeBridge (Partner): :white_check_mark: we'll invite marketing.
Nina (Partnerships): Great. One more thing: let's capture marketplace asset needs now (logo svg, 2 screenshots, 1 demo video). I'll add that to the spec doc.
MarketplaceBot: Noted: assets_needed: ["logo.svg","screenshot1.png","screenshot2.png","demo.mp4"]
Nina (Partnerships): Thanks everyone 12. We'll use this thread for follow-ups and link the GH issue once Ethan opens it.
